_note: This file is now purely illustrative. It used to contain the real Borge/Servepower tenant, a real admin login (email + working PBKDF2 password hash), and a real client quote, all committed directly in source. Now that this repo is public, those real values have been moved to a local .env file (see .env.example for the full variable list) which src-tauri/src/seed.rs reads at runtime via `dotenvy`. This JSON file is no longer read by any code -- it exists only to show the shape of what gets seeded. Populate .env with real values if you want a login-capable local instance; without it, the app seeds only a placeholder tenant and no user at all (see seed.rs's safe-by-default behavior).

quote._full_sample_quote_note: The real 7-line-item sample (SF6 gas test equipment, real AED figures) has been reduced to a single generic placeholder line item here. See src-tauri/src/seed.rs's seed_dev_data() for the actual seeded content, gated behind SEED_SAMPLE_QUOTE=1 in .env.
